sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: Sixty-two berths were inspected during the period. Four require remedial work before the winter season and are listed in the findings below.

sections.heading: Findings
sections.body: Berths B-14 and B-15 show fastener corrosion at the shoreward hinge. Berth C-02 has a damaged fender. Berth C-09 requires a replacement cleat.

sections.heading: Recommendations
sections.body: Schedule the four remedial items before the first freeze. Re-inspect the B row after the works and update the asset labels accordingly.
